# The goal pennant. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Banner --base-color 0.851 0.341 0.388 --no-slot
material new Gold --base-color 0.984 0.949 0.212 --no-slot
add mesh cube --size 1 --name Flag --location 0.48 0 0
scale 0.95 0.05 0.56
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Banner
active Flag
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 0.4"
scale 1 1 0.15
mode object
add mesh cube --size 1 --name Edge --location 0.05 0 0
scale 0.1 0.07 0.6
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Gold
select Flag Edge
active Flag
join
rename Flag Pennant
select all
shade flat
export pennant.glb
